column1: A collage of four tilted snapshot panels on bright cyan, the team as it first came together: a light-haired girl with a big bow at her collar, glancing sideways; an elegant girl with long dark hair falling over one eye; the joker of the group in a backwards baseball cap, grinning; and, largest, a silver-haired boy with a plaster on his brow and a calm, fighter's stare. Mismatched frames, one family in the making.
column2: 亮青色背景上，四张倾斜的快照拼成拼贴画，是团队最初聚在一起的样子：一个浅色头发的女孩，领口系着大蝴蝶结，斜眼看向一旁；一个优雅的女孩，黑色长发垂过一只眼睛；团队里的活宝，反戴着棒球帽，咧嘴笑着；最大的一张是一个银发少年，眉上贴着创可贴，目光平静，像个战士。边框参差不齐，一个家庭正在形成。

column1: A collage of five tilted snapshot panels on bright cyan: the elegant girl with dark hair over one eye, the light-haired girl with the bow, the grinning boy in his baseball cap and the silver-haired boy with the plaster on his brow, and, largest at the front, a newcomer: a shy, short-haired girl with wide gentle eyes and a high lace-patterned collar. The team is growing.
column2: 亮青色背景上，五张倾斜的快照拼成拼贴画：黑发遮住一只眼睛的优雅女孩，系着蝴蝶结的浅发女孩，戴着棒球帽咧嘴笑的男孩，眉上贴着创可贴的银发少年；最大、在最前面的是一位新成员：害羞的短发女孩，眼睛大而温柔，戴着高高的蕾丝花纹衣领。团队在壮大。

column1: A collage of six snapshot panels on bright cyan: the silver-haired boy with the plaster on his brow, the joker in his cap, the light-haired girl, the shy girl with the bob, the elegant girl with her big bow, and, largest, a blonde girl with round mechanical ear pieces, a calm, glassy gaze and a big bow at a white collar: the android who joined. The frames crowd closer together.
column2: 亮青色背景上，六张快照拼成拼贴画：眉上贴着创可贴的银发少年，戴帽子的活宝，浅发女孩，害羞的波波头女孩，系着大蝴蝶结的优雅女孩；最大的一张是金发女孩，戴着圆形机械耳饰，目光平静而剔透，白色衣领上系着大蝴蝶结，她就是加入团队的机器人。相框挤得更近了。

column1: A collage of seven snapshot panels on bright cyan: the shy girl with the bob, the joker, now sporting a little goatee and a cap with a peace badge, the light-haired girl, a strip of the android girl's wide eyes, the elegant girl, the silver-haired boy, and, taking the whole corner, a white Shiba dog with alert ears and his tongue lolling happily over his collar. Even the dog made the team photo.
column2: 亮青色背景上，七张快照拼成拼贴画：害羞的波波头女孩，如今留了小山羊胡、帽子上别着和平徽章的活宝，浅发女孩，机器人女孩睁大的双眼的一截画面，优雅的女孩，银发少年；占满整个角落的是一只白色柴犬，耳朵竖起，舌头开心地吐在项圈上。连狗狗也上了团队合照。

column1: A collage of eight snapshot panels on bright cyan: the elegant girl, a big close-up of the silver-haired boy's plastered brow, the android girl, the light-haired girl, the joker in his cap, the white dog's bright eyes, and, large at the bottom, a young boy with neat short hair and a serious little face in a school uniform, beside the shy girl with the bob. A full, busy board of friends.
column2: 亮青色背景上，八张快照拼成拼贴画：优雅的女孩，银发少年贴着创可贴的眉头的大特写，机器人女孩，浅发女孩，戴帽子的活宝，白狗明亮的眼睛；下方很大的一张是一个小男孩，头发整齐短短的，穿着校服，小脸严肃，站在害羞的波波头女孩身旁。满满当当的一板朋友。

column1: A collage of nine snapshot panels on bright cyan, the whole team at last: the joker's eyes under his cap, the shy girl with the bob, the silver-haired boy, the light-haired girl, a brooding young man in a beanie with a metal plate and a studded coat collar turned up, the white dog, a strip of the android girl's eyes, the elegant girl tall in her big bow, and the serious young boy in his uniform. Every face that stood together, crowded into one frame.
column2: 亮青色背景上，九张快照拼成拼贴画，团队终于到齐：帽檐下活宝的眼睛，害羞的波波头女孩，银发少年，浅发女孩，一个戴针织帽的阴沉青年，帽子上嵌着金属片，外套衣领竖起并缀着铆钉，白狗，机器人女孩眼睛的一截画面，系着大蝴蝶结、身形高挑的优雅女孩，以及穿着校服的严肃小男孩。一同站在一起的每一张脸，挤进了同一个画框。

column1: A boy with messy, short brown hair, his head tilted, one brow up and a lopsided, easy grin. School blazer with the crest on the pocket, shirt open at the neck and tie loose. Pure class-clown energy, always up for ramen or trouble.
column2: 一个男孩，短发凌乱，是棕色的，头歪向一边，一边眉毛挑起，笑得歪歪的，很随意。校服外套口袋上有校徽，衬衫领口敞开，领带松着。十足的班级活宝气质，随时奉陪拉面或麻烦事。

column1: A shy girl with a short, rounded bob and a straight fringe, wide gentle eyes and a soft, hesitant look. A high, lace-patterned collar tied with a ribbon peeks over a dark coat with large round buttons. Quiet, kind and a little fragile, like she'd apologise for taking up space.
column2: 一个害羞的女孩，短短的圆形波波头，齐刘海，眼睛大而温柔，神情柔和犹豫。深色外套上有大圆扣，露出系着丝带的高高的蕾丝花纹衣领。安静、善良，有一点脆弱，仿佛会为占了地方而道歉。

column1: A poised young woman with long, wavy hair swept over one eye, heavy-lidded eyes and the faintest cool smile. A soft white blouse with a huge, floppy bow at the throat. Regal and composed, the untouchable queen of the school.
column2: 一位端庄的年轻女子，长长的波浪卷发甩过一只眼睛，眼皮沉沉的，带着一丝若有若无的清冷微笑。柔软的白色衬衫，领口系着一个巨大蓬松的蝴蝶结。高贵而沉着，是校园里不可触碰的女王。

column1: A stern young man with slicked-back dark hair, a few strands falling loose, narrowed eyes and a smug half smile. Blazer buttoned, tie straight, and an official armband on his sleeve. The rules in human form, and he knows it.
column2: 一个严厉的青年，深色头发向后梳得光滑，有几缕散落下来，眼睛眯起，半带得意地笑着。西装外套扣好，领带端正，袖子上戴着正式的臂章。规则的化身，而且他自己清楚这一点。

column1: An old man with a wild cloud of white hair, bushy brows, a drooping moustache and rectangular glasses on his nose, leaning forward with a pipe in one hand. He wears a chunky sweater with a zig-zag pattern. A gruff, grandfatherly bookseller with a soft heart.
column2: 一位老人，一团蓬乱的白发，浓密的眉毛，下垂的小胡子，鼻梁上架着方形眼镜，身体前倾，一只手拿着烟斗。他穿着带锯齿花纹的厚毛衣。一位粗声粗气、像爷爷一样的书店老板，心地柔软。

column1: A small, stooped old woman with neat white hair, droopy, gentle eyes and a soft, faintly sad mouth. A leaf-patterned blouse under a dark apron. Sweet and warm, the kind of grandmother who always has a snack for you.
column2: 一位矮小驼背的老太太，白发整齐，眼睛下垂而温柔，嘴角柔和，带着一丝悲伤。深色围裙下是叶子花纹的上衣。亲切温暖，是那种总会给你留点零食的奶奶。

column1: A pretty girl with short hair flipping out at the ends, her head tilted with a shy, sidelong glance. A choker with a little heart buckle sits at her throat, above a wide-collared shirt with a big ribbon bow and a ribbed cardigan. Spirited and popular, but softer than she lets on.
column2: 一个漂亮的女孩，短发末梢向外翘起，头歪着，害羞地斜睨一眼。喉间一条带小爱心搭扣的颈带，下面是宽领衬衫，配大丝带蝴蝶结和罗纹开衫。活泼受欢迎，却比表面上柔软。

column1: A sporty boy with short, spiky dark hair, sharp eyes and a confident smirk over his shoulder. A high-collared track jacket zipped to the chin. All athlete's swagger and stubborn pride.
column2: 一个爱运动的男孩，短短的尖刺黑发，目光锐利，越过肩膀露出自信的坏笑。高领运动外套拉到下巴。满是运动员的神气和倔强的自尊。

column1: A girl with long, straight dark hair parted over a high forehead and thin rectangular glasses, one hand fidgeting at her bow, with a small, nervous smile. Neat school uniform. Bookish and timid, the student council's quiet treasurer.
column2: 一个女孩，长长的直黑发在高额头上分开，戴着细细的方形眼镜，一只手摆弄着蝴蝶结，露出一个小小的紧张笑容。整洁的校服。爱读书而胆小，是学生会安静的会计。

column1: Not a person but an avatar: a figure built from blocky polygons and flickering scan lines, like a low-resolution game character. Spiky angular hair, a pale face half hidden behind a high, armoured collar, one bright eye. The online friend, all pixels and mystery.
column2: 不是人，而是一个虚拟形象：由方块多边形和闪烁的扫描线构成的身影，像低分辨率游戏角色。尖尖的棱角分明的头发，苍白的脸有一半藏在高高的铠甲般的衣领后，一只明亮的眼睛。网上的朋友，满是像素和神秘。

column1: A boy with fluffy, curly hair and rectangular glasses, his head tilted with a sweet, slightly bashful smile. A neat school blazer with the crest on the pocket. Gentle and artistic, a quiet dreamer.
column2: 一个男孩，头发蓬松卷曲，戴着方形眼镜，头歪着，露出甜甜的、略带害羞的微笑。整洁的校服外套，口袋上有校徽。温柔而有艺术气质，是个安静的梦想家。

column1: A sporty girl with short dark hair flicking out behind, a hair clip above one eye, big bright eyes and lips parted as if mid-sentence. School blazer with a big bow. Energetic and caring, the team's devoted manager.
column2: 一个爱运动的女孩，短黑发在脑后翘起，一只眼睛上方别着发夹，大眼睛明亮，嘴唇微张，仿佛说话说到一半。校服外套上系着大蝴蝶结。精力充沛又体贴，是社团尽心尽力的经理。

column1: A little girl with her hair in a bun tied with a frilly scrunchie, freckles on her cheeks and a big, happy smile, hands gripping the straps of a school backpack over an open shirt. A cheerful kid trying very hard to be fine.
column2: 一个小女孩，头发盘成髻，系着带褶边的发圈，脸颊上有雀斑，笑得很开心，双手抓着书包肩带，衬衫敞着。一个开朗的孩子，正努力装作没事。

column1: A small boy with messy dark curls and a beauty mark beneath one eye, gazing out with a calm, unreadable expression. He wears a simple shirt with bold horizontal stripes. Innocent-looking, and quietly uncanny.
column2: 一个小男孩，深色卷发凌乱，一只眼睛下有颗美人痣，神情平静，让人看不透。他穿着一件粗横条纹的简单衬衫。看上去天真无邪，却暗暗有些诡异。

column1: A boy with a smooth, pale bowl cut, sleepy smiling eyes and a tiny earring, holding open a folding fan painted with butterflies in front of his school uniform. Dreamy and theatrical, in love with everything traditional.
column2: 一个男孩，光滑的浅色碗盖头，睡意朦胧、含笑的眼睛，戴着一枚小耳环，在校服前打开一把绘有蝴蝶的折扇。梦幻而富有戏剧感，热爱一切传统事物。

column1: A man in a light, slightly rumpled suit and tie, with shaggy dark hair, a sly sidelong look and a smug, knowing smirk. Slick, shady charm: the kind of salesman who'd sell you your own wallet.
column2: 一个男人，穿着浅色、有点皱的西装，系着领带，头发浓密蓬乱，深色，斜着眼睛，带着得意而心知肚明的坏笑。油滑可疑的魅力：那种会把你自己的钱包卖给你的推销员。

column1: A bald old monk with a deeply lined, scowling face, a thick cigarette pinched between his fingers, in dark robes with a white collar. Gruff, grumpy and drowning his sorrows, though there's more to him than the frown.
column2: 一位光头老僧，脸上皱纹深刻，神情阴沉，手指间夹着一支粗大的香烟，穿着深色僧袍，配白色衣领。粗声粗气、脾气暴躁，借酒浇愁，不过他不只是皱着眉头那么简单。

column1: A lean young man with short dark hair, confident brows and an easy, friendly smirk, in a white zip-up hoodie with a band of triangles down the sleeve. A star athlete, cheerful and a little cocky.
column2: 一个瘦削的青年，短短的深色头发，眉毛自信，笑容轻松友善，穿着白色拉链连帽衫，袖子上有一条三角形图案。一位明星运动员，开朗而有点自负。

column1: A chubby boy with a single curl sticking up from his hair, droopy, mournful eyes, puffed cheeks and a wobbling lip. School blazer and a ribbon tie. Comically sorry for himself, and surprisingly full of grand ideas.
column2: 一个胖乎乎的男孩，头发上翘起一缕卷毛，眼睛下垂，满是哀愁，脸颊鼓起，嘴唇颤抖。校服外套，系着丝带领结。可笑地自怜自艾，却出人意料地满脑子宏大的想法。

column1: A thin, pale young man with straight, shoulder-length hair, tired eyes and a wan, strained smile, in a shirt with bold vertical stripes. Fragile and wistful, looking back over his shoulder.
column2: 一个瘦弱苍白的青年，直发垂到肩膀，眼神疲惫，笑容苍白而勉强，穿着粗竖条纹衬衫。脆弱而惆怅，回头看向肩后。

column1: A collage of nine snapshot panels on bright cyan, the whole team together: the joker's eyes under his cap, the shy girl with the bob, the silver-haired boy, the light-haired girl, a brooding young man in a beanie with a metal plate and a studded coat collar, the white dog, a strip of the android girl's eyes, the elegant girl tall in her big bow, and the serious young boy in his uniform. Every face that stood together, crowded into one frame.
column2: 亮青色背景上，九张快照拼成拼贴画，整个团队在一起：帽檐下活宝的眼睛，害羞的波波头女孩，银发少年，浅发女孩，一个戴针织帽的阴沉青年，帽子上嵌着金属片，外套衣领缀着铆钉，白狗，机器人女孩眼睛的一截画面，系着大蝴蝶结、身形高挑的优雅女孩，以及穿着校服的严肃小男孩。一同站在一起的每一张脸，挤进了同一个画框。

column1: A girl with short blonde hair under a lattice-like metal headpiece, round mechanical ear units and a calm, gentle gaze. A big bow sits at her white collar, and jointed armour shows at her shoulders. An android with a very human softness in her eyes.
column2: 一个女孩，金色短发，戴着格子状的金属头饰，有圆形机械耳饰，目光平静温柔。白色衣领上系着大蝴蝶结，肩头露出有关节的铠甲。一个机器人，眼中却有着十分人性的柔和。

column1: On the school rooftop, Yukari stands at the railing with her back to you. She turns around to face you.
column2: 学校天台上，由加莉背对着你，站在栏杆旁。她转过身面对你。

column1: At a flower stall in the square by Port Island Station, you and Yukari stand with your school bags in hand, looking over buckets of flowers. Red and pink gerberas fill the front of the stall, and a woman minds it.
column2: 辰巳港湾人工岛站前广场的花摊旁，你和由加莉提着书包，看着一桶桶鲜花。摊位前面摆满红色和粉色的非洲菊，一位女士看着摊子。

column1: You and Yukari walk through Paulownia Mall's fountain square with your school bags. Yukari turns to you as she walks.
column2: 你和由加莉背着书包，走过桐叶购物中心的喷泉广场。由加莉边走边转向你。

column1: A small boy stands alone in the square, crying and rubbing his eyes with his arm. Yukari walks over to him, and you follow.
column2: 一个小男孩独自站在广场上，用胳膊揉着眼睛哭泣。由加莉走向他，你跟在后面。

column1: Yukari leads the boy across the square to the police box. Afterwards, the boy sits inside with a police officer while you and Yukari stand outside.
column2: 由加莉带着男孩穿过广场，来到派出所。之后，男孩和一名警察坐在里面，你和由加莉站在外面。

column1: You and Yukari stand by the fountain in Paulownia Mall.
column2: 你和由加莉站在桐叶购物中心的喷泉旁。

column1: Yukari steps away from you and takes out her phone. She looks at the screen for a moment before she answers.
column2: 由加莉从你身边走开，拿出手机。她看了一会儿屏幕，才接起电话。

column1: Yukari ends the call and stands staring at her phone, then lowers it.
column2: 由加莉挂断电话，站着盯着手机，然后放下了手。

column1: Later, you and Yukari sit side by side on a bench by the fountain.
column2: 过了一会儿，你和由加莉并肩坐在喷泉旁的长椅上。

column1: You and Yukari walk up to the front of Wilduck Burger with your school bags. Yukari turns to face you.
column2: 你和由加莉背着书包，走到怀老鸭汉堡前。由加莉转身面对你。

column1: Yukari runs off down the street, leaving you standing alone outside the burger shop.
column2: 由加莉沿着街道跑开，把你一个人留在汉堡店外。

column1: In a back corner at the foot of a stairway, beside a vending machine, three young men stand around Yukari.
column2: 在楼梯脚下一处背街的角落里，自动贩卖机旁，三个年轻男人围在由加莉身边。

column1: You run up and stop a few steps behind Yukari.
column2: 你跑过去，在由加莉身后几步远停下。

column1: You walk past Yukari and plant yourself between her and the men.
column2: 你从由加莉身边走过，站到她和那几个男人之间。

column1: You take a fighting stance, and the fight with the three men is quick. When it is over the men are gone, and you stand alone with Yukari.
column2: 你摆开架势，和三个男人的打斗很快结束。结束时男人们都不见了，只剩你和由加莉站在那里。

column1: Yukari turns and walks away, leaving you behind.
column2: 由加莉转身走开，把你留在身后。

column1: On the school rooftop, Yukari stands with her back to you, then turns around to face you.
column2: 学校天台上，由加莉背对着你站着，然后转过身面对你。

column1: Yukari bows to you.
column2: 由加莉向你鞠躬。

column1: In a small set-meal restaurant, you and Yukari sit across a table from each other, each with the same tray of fish, rice and small side bowls.
column2: 在一家小小的定食店里，你和由加莉隔着桌子相对而坐，各自面前是同样的托盘，上面有鱼、米饭和小碗小菜。

column1: You and Yukari walk across Paulownia Mall's fountain square with your school bags.
column2: 你和由加莉背着书包，走过桐叶购物中心的喷泉广场。

column1: Yukari stops, turns away from you and takes out her phone. She looks at the screen, then answers.
column2: 由加莉停下，转过身背对你，拿出手机。她看了看屏幕，然后接起电话。

column1: On the school rooftop, Yukari stands at the railing with her back to you. You walk up behind her.
column2: 学校天台上，由加莉背对着你，站在栏杆旁。你走到她身后。

column1: Yukari is in tears. You walk over to her, and the two of you hold each other close.
column2: 由加莉在流泪。你走到她身边，两人紧紧相拥。

column1: Yukari breaks away from you and runs off. A door closes behind her.
column2: 由加莉挣脱你，跑开了。一扇门在她身后关上。

column1: Yukari runs off across the rooftop. A door closes behind her.
column2: 由加莉跑过天台。一扇门在她身后关上。

column1: In Yukari's room at the dorm, you and Yukari sit side by side on the edge of her bed.
column2: 在宿舍由加莉的房间里，你和由加莉并肩坐在她的床沿上。

column1: Yukari holds out her phone strap, a little charm hanging from it, and places it in your hand.
column2: 由加莉举起她的手机挂绳，上面挂着一个小饰品，把它放进你的手里。

column1: In Paulownia Mall's fountain square, a small boy runs up near you and Yukari and stops, on his own.
column2: 桐叶购物中心的喷泉广场上，一个小男孩独自跑到你和由加莉附近，停了下来。

column1: Yukari walks over to the boy, and he turns and wanders a few steps away.
column2: 由加莉走向男孩，他转身走开了几步。

column1: The boy and his mother walk off across the square together. Yukari watches them go.
column2: 男孩和他的妈妈一起走过广场。由加莉目送他们离开。

column1: Later, you and Yukari sit side by side on a bench.
column2: 过了一会儿，你和由加莉并肩坐在长椅上。

column1: You and Yukari step out of the door of Mandragora, the karaoke bar, and stop on the landing outside. Yukari has her bag in hand.

column2: 你和明彦做菜的时候时间过去了；平底锅的叮当声一直响着。结束时，料理台边的盘子上摆着三大摞冒着热气的松饼。

column1: Yukari and Fuuka walk over to the kitchen.
column2: 由加莉和风花走向厨房。

column1: Later, everyone gathers at the dining table around the pancakes: Yukari, Junpei, Mitsuru, Fuuka, Ken, Aigis and Koromaru, with you and Akihiko.
column2: 过了一会儿，大家聚在餐桌旁，围着松饼：由加莉、顺平、美鹤、风花、乾、埃癸斯和虎狼丸，还有你和明彦。

column1: Everyone eats together. When the plates are empty, Ken comes over to you and Akihiko.
column2: 大家一起吃着。盘子空了以后，乾走到你和明彦身旁。

column1: Ken turns and walks off, leaving you and Akihiko standing by the table, Akihiko with his hands on his hips.
column2: 乾转身走开，把你和明彦留在桌边，明彦双手叉着腰。

column1: Akihiko breaks off and winces in pain.
column2: 明彦话说到一半停下，痛得皱起脸。

column1: You stand with Akihiko at Naganaki Shrine, worn out after training alongside him.
column2: 你和明彦站在长鸣神社，和他一起训练得筋疲力尽。

column1: A gang of about ten men walks up and spreads out around you both, led by the men from before.
column2: 大约十个男人的一伙人走来，在你们周围散开，带头的是先前的那几个人。

column1: You step up beside Akihiko and raise your fists. Akihiko looks at you in surprise.
column2: 你走到明彦身旁，举起拳头。明彦惊讶地看着你。

column1: The gang rushes you, and a fight breaks out. Soon every one of them is beaten, slumped on the ground around you, and Akihiko walks over to you.
column2: 那伙人冲向你，一场打斗爆发。很快他们全被打倒，瘫在你周围的地上，明彦走向你。

column1: Akihiko leads you into his room in the dorm. Trophies crowd the shelves, and a punching bag and a speed bag hang among the furniture.
column2: 明彦带你走进宿舍里他的房间。奖杯挤满架子，一个沙袋和一个速度球挂在家具之间。

column1: You sit down, and Akihiko stays standing across from you.
column2: 你坐下，明彦仍站在你对面。

column1: Akihiko turns away, walks across the room and starts searching.
column2: 明彦转过身，穿过房间，开始翻找。

column1: You get up and walk over to his desk, where the medal from his parents' parcel lies on its ribbon. Akihiko comes over and stands beside you.
column2: 你站起来走到他的书桌旁，他父母寄来的包裹里的奖牌放在丝带上。明彦走过来，站到你身旁。

column1: Akihiko picks the medal up from his desk and hands it to you. You hang it around his neck, and he looks down at it in surprise.
column2: 明彦从书桌上拿起奖牌，递给你。你把它挂在他的脖子上，他低头看着它，吃惊不已。

column1: Kurosawa walks up to you and Akihiko with another police officer. He has a quick word with the officer, who nods and moves off.
column2: 黑泽走向你和明彦，带着另一名警察。他和那名警察简单说了几句，警察点点头走开了。

column1: Akihiko, who turned aside for a moment, steps back up to you and hands you a pair of his hand wraps.
column2: 明彦刚才转身走开了片刻，又走回你身旁，递给你一副他的绑手带。

column1: You and Akihiko are at the cinema.
column2: 你和明彦在电影院。

column1: You take your seats among the audience and watch the film together, Akihiko with his arms folded.
column2: 你们在观众中就座，一起看电影，明彦双臂抱在胸前。

column1: You and Akihiko sit side by side on a sofa in the dorm lounge, watching a boxing match on the TV: Akihiko with his arms and legs crossed, you leaning forward, elbows on your knees and hands clasped.
column2: 你和明彦并肩坐在宿舍休息区的沙发上，看着电视里的拳击比赛：明彦双臂双腿交叉，你身体前倾，手肘撑在膝盖上，双手交握。

column1: You and Akihiko sit side by side on the sofa in the dorm lounge, watching a professional boxing match on the TV. Akihiko sits with his arms and legs crossed.
column2: 你和明彦并肩坐在宿舍休息区的沙发上，看着电视里的职业拳击比赛。明彦双臂双腿交叉坐着。

column1: You and Akihiko sit side by side in the dorm lounge, Akihiko with his arms folded, watching a boxing match on the TV. The bell rings to end it.
column2: 你和明彦并肩坐在宿舍休息区，明彦双臂抱在胸前，看着电视里的拳击比赛。铃声响起，比赛结束。

column1: You and Akihiko sit side by side on the sofa in the dorm lounge, facing the TV, where he has put on a video. Akihiko sits with his arms and legs crossed; you lean forward, hands clasped between your knees.
column2: 你和明彦并肩坐在宿舍休息区的沙发上，面对电视，他放了一段录像。明彦双臂双腿交叉坐着；你身体前倾，双手交握在两膝之间。

column1: What plays is not a champion's bout but an old recording of a small boxing match, the crowd's voices coming through the speakers. Akihiko stares at the screen.
column2: 播放的不是冠军的比赛，而是一场小型拳击赛的旧录像，观众的声音从扬声器里传出来。明彦盯着屏幕。

column1: You stand with Akihiko at the dorm kitchen counter, a bowl of eggs and packs of raw meat laid out, and Akihiko gestures at them.
column2: 你和明彦站在宿舍厨房的料理台旁，台上摆着一碗鸡蛋和几包生肉，明彦朝它们比画着。

column1: Later, the cooking is done: plates of sliced chicken sit on the counter, and Akihiko folds his arms.
column2: 过了一会儿，做好了：料理台上放着几盘切好的鸡肉，明彦双臂抱在胸前。

column1: You stand with Akihiko in the dorm kitchen, the ingredients laid out by the cutting board.
column2: 你和明彦站在宿舍厨房里，食材摆在砧板旁。

column1: Time passes while the two of you boil everything and portion it out. Afterwards the counter is cleared, and Akihiko stands beside you with his arms crossed.
column2: 你们煮好所有东西并分好份的时候，时间过去了。之后料理台收拾干净，明彦双臂交叉站在你身旁。

column1: Time passes while the two of you cook; then the finished stir-fry sits on plates on the counter, and Akihiko folds his arms.
column2: 你们做菜的时候，时间过去了；然后做好的炒菜盛在盘子里放在料理台上，明彦双臂抱在胸前。

column1: You and Akihiko stand in the dorm kitchen, a clay hotpot on the counter by the stove. You break into a nervous sweat.
column2: 你和明彦站在宿舍厨房里，炉灶旁的料理台上放着一口陶制火锅。你开始冒冷汗。

column1: Later, the two of you are at the dining table with a hotpot simmering between you, bowls, chopsticks and glasses of water set out.
column2: 过了一会儿，你们两人在餐桌旁，中间炖着一锅火锅，碗、筷子和水杯已摆好。

column1: The footage shows Akihiko alone in his dorm room, scowling as he throws punches beside a hanging punching bag.
column2: 画面显示明彦独自在宿舍房间里，皱着眉，在一个悬挂的沙袋旁出拳。

column1: He stops, turns away and walks over to his desk, where he leans over something lying open and reads.
column2: 他停下来，转身走到书桌旁，俯身看着摊开的东西读起来。

column1: He turns from the desk, steps out into the middle of the room and faces the empty space with a smile, as if someone were standing there.
column2: 他从书桌转过身，走到房间中央，面对空荡荡的地方微笑，仿佛那里站着谁。

column1: In the entrance hall of Tartarus, you walk in with Akihiko, Yukari, Junpei and Mitsuru. The others walk on ahead; Akihiko stops beside you and turns to face you.
column2: 塔尔塔罗斯的大厅。你和明彦、由加莉、顺平、美鹤一起走进来。其他人走在前面；明彦在你身旁停下，转身面对你。

column1: At the counter of Hagakure Ramen, you sit on a stool beside Mitsuru. The shop's owner works behind the counter.
column2: 叶隐拉面的柜台前，你坐在美鹤旁边的凳子上。店主在柜台后忙碌。

column1: Mitsuru starts on her bowl of ramen, and you eat beside her.
column2: 美鹤开始吃她的那碗拉面，你在她身旁吃着。

column1: In Wilduck Burger, you sit at a table across from Mitsuru, trays of burgers and drinks between you. Mitsuru sits with her arms crossed, the food untouched.
column2: 怀老鸭汉堡里，你坐在美鹤对面的桌旁，汉堡和饮料的托盘放在你们之间。美鹤双臂交叉坐着，食物没有动。

column1: At Iwatodai Strip Mall, you stand with Mitsuru in front of a takoyaki stand, where a vendor is at work.
column2: 严户台站前商店街，你和美鹤站在一个章鱼烧摊前，摊贩正在忙碌。

column1: Mitsuru walks up to the stand to order, and you follow her.
column2: 美鹤走到摊前点餐，你跟着她。

column1: Later, you sit side by side on a low ledge, a tray of takoyaki on Mitsuru's lap, and she takes her first bite, eyes closing as she chews.
column2: 过了一会儿，你们并肩坐在一处矮台阶上，美鹤的膝上放着一盘章鱼烧，她咬下第一口，边嚼边闭上了眼睛。

column1: In the school library, you sit at a table with Mitsuru, stacks of books piled in front of her.
column2: 学校图书馆里，你和美鹤坐在一张桌旁，她面前堆着一摞摞的书。

column1: Coming out of the film, Mitsuru walks a few steps ahead of you, then turns back to face you.
column2: 走出电影院，美鹤在你前面走了几步，然后转身面对你。

column1: In the school library, you stand beside Mitsuru, both facing the shelves; another student stands farther off. After a moment, she turns around to face you.
column2: 学校图书馆里，你站在美鹤身旁，两人面对着书架；另一名学生站得更远。过了一会儿，她转过身面对你。

column1: Mitsuru lowers the hand she has held to her chest, turns and walks away, leaving you alone in the library.
column2: 美鹤放下一直按在胸前的手，转身走开，把你一个人留在图书馆里。

column1: Back at Wilduck Burger, you share a table of burgers and drinks with Mitsuru, other customers waiting at the counter behind.
column2: 回到怀老鸭汉堡，你和美鹤共用一张摆着汉堡和饮料的桌子，其他顾客在后面的柜台前等候。

column1: In the plaza outside the cinema at Port Island Station, Mitsuru walks out ahead of you, stops and turns to you.
column2: 辰巳港湾人工岛站前电影院外的广场上，美鹤走在你前面，停下，转向你。

column1: A well-dressed man walks up to you and Mitsuru.
column2: 一个衣着体面的男人走向你和美鹤。

column1: The man turns and runs off across the plaza.
column2: 男人转身跑过广场。

column1: Sweating, the man turns and runs off across the plaza.
column2: 男人满头大汗，转身跑过广场。

column1: Mitsuru turns away from you and runs off, leaving you standing there.
column2: 美鹤转身离开你跑开了，把你留在原地。

column1: Mitsuru walks ahead of you to the railing of the school rooftop, with no one else around, and stops. When she faces you, she keeps her head lowered and her eyes turned aside.
column2: 美鹤走在你前面，来到学校天台的栏杆旁，周围没有别人，她停下。她面对你时，低着头，目光移向一旁。

column1: Mitsuru stands with a hand on her hip. You step close to her and hold her in your arms. She starts in surprise, then smiles.
column2: 美鹤一手叉腰站着。你走近她，把她抱在怀里。她吃了一惊，然后笑了。

column1: You sit side by side with Mitsuru on a sofa in her room at the dorm.
column2: 你和美鹤并肩坐在她宿舍房间的沙发上。

column1: Mitsuru glances away, then leans over and holds out a key, and you take it.
column2: 美鹤移开视线，然后探身过来递出一把钥匙，你接了过来。

column1: Mitsuru closes her eyes, turns her face aside and touches her hair.
column2: 美鹤闭上眼睛，把脸转向一旁，摸了摸头发。

column1: You and Mitsuru sit down facing each other on ornate sofas in her room at the dorm, a teapot, cups, a vase of flowers and a basket of snacks on the low table between you. Mitsuru sits with her legs and arms crossed.
column2: 你和美鹤面对面坐在她宿舍房间里华丽的沙发上，矮桌上放着茶壶、杯子、一瓶花和一篮点心。美鹤双腿和双臂交叉坐着。

column1: In front of the dorm, Mitsuru bends over her motorcycle, checking it over, then straightens with a hand on her hip.
column2: 宿舍前，美鹤俯身查看她的摩托车，然后直起身，一只手叉着腰。

column1: Mitsuru holds out a key. You step forward and take it.
column2: 美鹤递出一把钥匙。你上前一步接了过来。

column1: At the Iwatodai strip mall, you and Mitsuru step out of the door of the beef bowl shop and stop outside it to talk, a man leaning on a post nearby. Mitsuru touches a hand to her cheek.
column2: 严户台站前商店街，你和美鹤走出牛肉盖饭店的门，在外面停下说话，附近有一个男人靠在柱子上。美鹤用手摸着脸颊。

column1: Outside the arcade at Paulownia Mall, beside a prize crane machine, Mitsuru walks a few steps ahead of you, then stops and turns to you with a smile, a hand on her hip. Later, as she talks, she folds her hands in front of her and lowers her eyes.
column2: 桐叶购物中心的游戏中心外，在一台夹娃娃机旁，美鹤走在你前面几步，然后停下，笑着转向你，一只手叉着腰。后来，她说话时，双手在身前交握，垂下了眼睛。

column1: Outside a record shop in Paulownia Mall, you and Mitsuru walk out together and stop to talk. Mitsuru is smiling, a hand on her hip.
column2: 桐叶购物中心的唱片店外，你和美鹤一起走出来，停下说话。美鹤微笑着，一只手叉着腰。

column1: You and Mitsuru sit across from each other at a café table, steaming cups of coffee in front of you; a woman sits at the next table. Mitsuru sits with her arms folded.
column2: 你和美鹤隔着咖啡馆的桌子相对而坐，面前是冒着热气的咖啡；邻桌坐着一位女士。美鹤双臂抱在胸前坐着。

column1: In Wakatsu, the set-meal restaurant at the Iwatodai strip mall, you and Mitsuru sit across a table from each other, plates of fried food, rice and soup in front of you.
column2: 在严户台站前商店街的定食店若津，你和美鹤隔着桌子相对而坐，面前是炸物、米饭和汤。

column1: At the Iwatodai strip mall, among passing shoppers, you and Mitsuru walk along together. Mitsuru stops, turns to face you and smiles.
column2: 严户台站前商店街，在往来购物的人们中间，你和美鹤并肩走着。美鹤停下，转身面对你，微笑着。

column1: In the burger shop at the Iwatodai strip mall, you and Mitsuru sit together at a table, a few other customers seated nearby and a clerk behind the counter.
column2: 严户台站前商店街的汉堡店里，你和美鹤一起坐在桌旁，附近坐着几位其他顾客，柜台后有一位店员。

column1: In the cinema lobby, you and Mitsuru stand together by the snack counter.
column2: 电影院大厅里，你和美鹤一起站在小卖部柜台旁。

column1: In the screening room, you and Mitsuru sit side by side among the audience, watching the film.
column2: 放映厅里，你和美鹤并肩坐在观众中，看着电影。

column1: Afterwards, you and Mitsuru stand facing each other by the snack counter in the lobby.
column2: 之后，你和美鹤面对面站在大厅的小卖部柜台旁。

column1: In your classroom, you sit at your desk. Mitsuru walks in, her bag in hand, and stops a few steps from you, her head lowered and her eyes turned aside.
column2: 你的教室里，你坐在座位上。美鹤提着包走进来，在离你几步远处停下，低着头，目光移向一旁。

column1: Fountain Square at Paulownia Mall, hung with Christmas decorations. You and Mitsuru walk across the square side by side.
column2: 桐叶购物中心的喷泉广场，挂满圣诞装饰。你和美鹤并肩走过广场。

column1: Later, you and Mitsuru sit side by side on a bench beside the fountain to rest after your walk.
column2: 过了一会儿，散步之后，你和美鹤并肩坐在喷泉旁的长椅上休息。

column1: Mitsuru takes out a gift and holds it out to you, and you take it from her hands.
column2: 美鹤拿出一份礼物递给你，你从她手中接过。

column1: Fountain Square at Paulownia Mall. You and Mitsuru stop walking, and she takes out her phone to check the time. Later she turns her face away from you, off to the side.
column2: 桐叶购物中心的喷泉广场。你和美鹤停下脚步，她拿出手机查看时间。后来她把脸转向一旁，不看你。

column1: The student council room at Gekkoukan High. You and Mitsuru walk in together, and she stops to look around the room.
column2: 月光馆学园的学生会办公室。你和美鹤一起走进来，她停下来环顾房间。

column1: Mitsuru wanders slowly across the room to the window and gazes out, then turns back to face you.
column2: 美鹤慢慢走过房间，来到窗边向外凝望，然后转身面对你。

column1: The lounge of the dorm. You and Mitsuru sit near each other, each reading one of her books. Later she has set hers down on the table and sits with her arms folded while you read on.
column2: 宿舍休息区。你和美鹤坐在彼此附近，各自读着她的一本书。后来她把自己那本放在桌上，双臂抱在胸前坐着，你继续读下去。

column1: The dorm lounge. You and Mitsuru sit on benches on either side of a low table, each reading one of the books she has brought.
column2: 宿舍休息区。你和美鹤分别坐在矮桌两侧的长椅上，各自读着她带来的一本书。

column1: Some time later, you are still deep in one of her books, turning page after page. Mitsuru has set hers down on the table and sits back with her arms folded, watching you with a smile.
column2: 过了一段时间，你仍沉浸在她的一本书里，一页一页地翻着。美鹤把她的书放在桌上，向后靠着，双臂抱在胸前，微笑着看你。

column1: The dorm lounge. You and Mitsuru sit on benches on either side of a low table, each reading a book.
column2: 宿舍休息区。你和美鹤分别坐在矮桌两侧的长椅上，各自读着一本书。

column1: Later, Mitsuru has closed her book and laid it on the table; she sits with her arms folded.
column2: 过了一会儿，美鹤合上书放在桌上；她双臂抱在胸前坐着。

column1: The lounge of the dorm. You and Mitsuru sit on separate benches across a low table, each reading a book.
column2: 宿舍休息区。你和美鹤分别坐在隔着矮桌的两张长椅上，各自读着一本书。

column1: Later, the books are set aside; Mitsuru sits with her arms folded.
column2: 过了一会儿，书放到了一旁；美鹤双臂抱在胸前坐着。

column1: The dorm kitchen. You and Mitsuru stand at the counter, a teapot and two cups on saucers set out by the sink.
column2: 宿舍厨房。你和美鹤站在料理台旁，水槽边放着一个茶壶和两只带茶碟的杯子。

column1: Later, you sit with Mitsuru on the lounge sofa, a plate of karume-yaki on the low table. She sips the tea you blended, eyes closed, while you lean forward with your hands clasped.
column2: 过了一会儿，你和美鹤坐在休息区的沙发上，矮桌上放着一盘轻目烧。她闭着眼睛啜饮你调配的茶，你身体前倾，双手交握。

column1: The dorm lounge. You sit beside Mitsuru on the sofa, cups of tea and a basket of snacks on the table in front of you. She sits with her arms folded; you lean forward, elbows on your knees.
column2: 宿舍休息区。你坐在美鹤身旁的沙发上，面前的桌上放着茶杯和一篮点心。她双臂抱在胸前坐着；你身体前倾，手肘撑在膝盖上。

column1: The dorm lounge. You sit beside Mitsuru on the sofa, cups of tea and a basket of snacks on the table in front of you, Mitsuru playing host. You lean forward with your hands clasped; she sits with her arms loosely folded.
column2: 宿舍休息区。你坐在美鹤身旁的沙发上，面前的桌上放着茶杯和一篮点心，美鹤做东道主。你身体前倾，双手交握；她双臂松松地抱在胸前坐着。

column1: The dorm kitchen. You stand at the counter with Mitsuru, ready to cook together.
column2: 宿舍厨房。你和美鹤站在料理台旁，准备一起做菜。

column1: Later, you and Mitsuru sit side by side on the lounge sofa, still in your aprons, cups of tea and a plate of the karume-yaki you made on the low table in front of you. Mitsuru sits with her arms folded.
column2: 过了一会儿，你和美鹤并肩坐在休息区的沙发上，还系着围裙，矮桌上放着茶杯和一盘你们做的轻目烧。美鹤双臂抱在胸前坐着。

column1: The footage shows Mitsuru's room in the dorm. Mitsuru walks in wrapped in a bath towel and sits down in an armchair beside a low table.
column2: 画面显示美鹤在宿舍的房间。美鹤裹着浴巾走进来，在矮桌旁的扶手椅上坐下。

column1: Mitsuru picks up a magazine from the table and opens it, leafing through the pages.
column2: 美鹤从桌上拿起一本杂志，翻开，一页页地翻看。

column1: Mitsuru sets the magazine back down, then gets up and walks away across the room.
column2: 美鹤把杂志放回桌上，然后站起来，走过房间。

column1: You sit with Fuuka in the open-air corridor behind the school building, a bento box she has made between you.
column2: 你和风花坐在校舍后面的露天走廊里，中间放着她做的便当盒。

column1: You eat a mouthful from the bento, your face tightens in pain, and you hunch forward, elbows on your knees.
column2: 你吃了一口便当，脸痛苦地皱起来，弯下身子，手肘撑在膝盖上。

column1: Fuuka jumps up and runs off. She comes back with water, you drink it down, and she sits beside you again, her head lowered.
column2: 风花跳起来跑开了。她拿着水回来，你一口喝下，她又坐到你身旁，低着头。

column1: You sit with Fuuka in the open-air corridor behind the school building again. A stray cat pads up to you.
column2: 你又和风花坐在校舍后面的露天走廊里。一只流浪猫走到你身边。

column1: Fuuka crouches and sets the open bento down in front of the cat. The cat sniffs it, jerks back and darts away.
column2: 风花蹲下，把打开的便当放在猫面前。猫闻了闻，猛地退开，窜走了。

column1: Fuuka tries a bite of the bento herself.
column2: 风花自己试着吃了一口便当。

column1: You walk home through the Iwatodai strip mall with Fuuka, school bags in hand. She stops and turns to you, holding her bag in front of her with both hands.
column2: 你和风花穿过严户台站前商店街走回家，提着书包。她停下，转向你，双手把包抱在身前。

column1: You wait outside a shop in Paulownia Mall. Fuuka comes back over to you, holding her school bag in front of her with both hands, looking downcast, and you scratch the back of your head as she talks.
column2: 你在桐叶购物中心的一家店外等候。风花回到你身边，双手把书包抱在身前，神情沮丧，她说话时你挠着后脑勺。

column1: You sit with Fuuka on a curved bench on the school rooftop, a small box on her lap.
column2: 你和风花坐在学校天台的弧形长椅上，她的膝上放着一个小盒子。

column1: Fuuka gives you a rice ball she made, and you eat it while she watches, a bead of sweat on her brow.
column2: 风花递给你一个她做的饭团，你吃着，她在一旁看着，额头上冒着一滴汗。

column1: You sit beside Fuuka on a bench on the school rooftop. She keeps her hands folded in her lap; you lean forward, elbows on your knees.
column2: 你坐在学校天台长椅上的风花身旁。她双手交叠放在膝上；你身体前倾，手肘撑在膝盖上。

column1: You and Fuuka stand outside the bookstore in the Iwatodai strip mall, school bags in hand. Fuuka looks downcast, holding her bag in front of her.
column2: 你和风花站在严户台站前商店街的书店外，提着书包。风花神情沮丧，把包抱在身前。

column1: Fuuka presses a hand to her chest.
column2: 风花把一只手按在胸口。

column1: You sit beside Fuuka on a bench on the school rooftop. She keeps her hands in her lap, now and then lifting one to her chest; you lean forward, elbows on your knees.
column2: 你坐在学校天台长椅上的风花身旁。她的双手放在膝上，不时抬起一只手按在胸口；你身体前倾，手肘撑在膝盖上。

column1: You stand facing Fuuka by the railing on the school rooftop. She keeps a hand pressed to her chest, and later clasps her hands in front of her.
column2: 你面对风花，站在学校天台的栏杆旁。她一只手一直按在胸口，后来双手在身前交握。

column1: You sit on a cushion by a low table in Fuuka's room at the dorm. Fuuka kneels facing you, fidgeting with her hands.
column2: 你坐在宿舍风花房间矮桌旁的坐垫上。风花面对你跪坐着，手不安地动着。

column1: Fuuka holds out a pair of headphones, and you take them.
column2: 风花递出一副耳机，你接了过来。

column1: Fuuka now kneels close beside you, a hand pressed to her chest.
column2: 风花现在跪坐在你身旁很近的地方，一只手按在胸口。

column1: You sit beside Fuuka at the counter of Hagakure, the ramen shop. Fuuka sits upright with her hands in her lap, gazing up at the menu boards on the wall. Another customer sits at the far end of the counter.
column2: 你坐在拉面店叶隐的柜台前，风花身旁。风花坐得笔直，双手放在膝上，抬头望着墙上的菜单牌。柜台远端坐着另一位顾客。

column1: You stand facing Fuuka by the railing on the school rooftop, one hand in your pocket. Fuuka keeps a hand near her chest as she talks, and later clasps her hands behind her back.
column2: 你面对风花，站在学校天台的栏杆旁，一只手插在口袋里。风花说话时一只手靠近胸口，后来双手背在身后交握。

column1: You are in the dorm kitchen with Fuuka, making gyoza.
column2: 你和风花在宿舍厨房里做煎饺。

column1: Yukari walks into the kitchen.
column2: 由加莉走进厨房。

column1: The gyoza are cooked. You sit at the dining table with Fuuka and Yukari, each with a plate of gyoza, a bowl of rice and a dipping dish.
column2: 煎饺做好了。你和风花、由加莉坐在餐桌旁，每人面前有一盘煎饺、一碗米饭和一个蘸料碟。

column1: Yukari walks off, leaving you and Fuuka at the table.
column2: 由加莉走开了，把你和风花留在桌边。

column1: You and Fuuka step out of a sweets shop and stop in front of its window to talk.
column2: 你和风花走出一家甜品店，在橱窗前停下说话。

column1: You and Fuuka sit at a table in a small restaurant, a set meal on a tray in front of each of you, chopsticks in hand. Two other customers sit chatting nearby.
column2: 你和风花坐在一家小餐厅的桌旁，各自面前是托盘上的一份定食，手里拿着筷子。附近有另外两位顾客在聊天。

column1: In Paulownia Mall, you and Fuuka walk out of a music shop and stop outside it, your hands in your pockets.
column2: 在桐叶购物中心，你和风花走出一家音乐店，在店外停下，双手插在口袋里。

column1: You and Fuuka sit together at a table in a cake shop's café, other customers at the tables around you.
column2: 你和风花一起坐在蛋糕店咖啡馆的桌旁，周围的桌边坐着其他顾客。

column1: You and Fuuka sit side by side on a curved bench on the school rooftop, your bags at your feet.
column2: 你和风花并肩坐在学校天台的弧形长椅上，书包放在脚边。

column1: You sit side by side with Fuuka on the edge of her bed in her room at the dorm, a little apart, her hands folded in her lap.
column2: 你和风花并肩坐在宿舍她房间的床沿上，隔开一点距离，她的双手叠放在膝上。

column1: The summer festival at Naganaki Shrine: food stalls line the grounds and people stroll past in yukatas. You stand beside Fuuka, who is wearing a yukata too.
column2: 长鸣神社的夏日祭典：美食摊位排满境内，人们穿着浴衣走过。你站在风花身旁，她也穿着浴衣。

column1: You and Fuuka make your way through the crowd to a takoyaki stall, where a woman works behind the grill.
column2: 你和风花穿过人群，来到一个章鱼烧摊前，一位女士在烤盘后忙碌。

column1: Standing off to one side with the takoyaki, Fuuka lifts one to her mouth and takes a bite.
column2: 风花站在一旁，拿着章鱼烧，举起一个送到嘴边，咬了一口。

column1: At the lucky-draw stall, you reach into the box and draw a ticket while Fuuka watches.
column2: 在幸运抽奖摊前，你把手伸进箱子里抽出一张券，风花在一旁看着。

column1: In the lobby of the cinema, you and Fuuka stand by the snack counter, Fuuka holding her bag in front of her with both hands.
column2: 在电影院大厅里，你和风花站在小卖部柜台旁，风花双手把包抱在身前。

column1: You and Fuuka sit side by side among the audience as the film plays, hands folded in your laps.
column2: 电影放映时，你和风花并肩坐在观众中，双手叠放在膝上。

column1: You are sitting at your desk in the classroom when Fuuka walks over to you, holding her bag in front of her with both hands.
column2: 你坐在教室的座位上，风花走到你身旁，双手把包抱在身前。

column1: Fountain Square, decorated for Christmas and busy with people. You and Fuuka walk in side by side and stop to take in the decorations.
column2: 喷泉广场，装饰着圣诞饰品，人来人往。你和风花并肩走进来，停下来欣赏装饰。

column1: The two of you walk on to a quieter spot by the doors of a café, people passing now and then. Fuuka stops and turns to you, smiling.
column2: 你们两人走到咖啡馆门口较安静的地方，偶尔有人经过。风花停下，微笑着转向你。

column1: Fuuka holds out the cookies she baked herself, and you take them.
column2: 风花递出她亲手烤的曲奇，你接了过来。

column1: Fuuka steps a little closer to you.
column2: 风花朝你走近了一点。

column1: Fountain Square. You and Fuuka sit side by side on a bench by the fountain, her bag beside her, with a few people still passing. Fuuka keeps her hands in her lap and now and then looks down.
column2: 喷泉广场。你和风花并肩坐在喷泉旁的长椅上，她的包放在身边，还有几个人在路过。风花双手放在膝上，不时低下头。

column1: A hallway at school, outside the faculty office, by a notice board. You are with Fuuka when a teacher walks up to her, and she presses a hand to her chest.
column2: 学校走廊里，教师办公室外，布告栏旁。你和风花在一起，一位老师走向她，她把一只手按在胸口。

column1: Mr. Ekoda walks off down the hall, passing between you and Fuuka. Fuuka turns to you, her face falling.
column2: 江古田老师沿走廊走开，从你和风花之间经过。风花转向你，脸色沉了下来。

column1: Fuuka hurries off a few steps, then stops and turns back to you.
column2: 风花匆匆走开几步，然后停下，转回身看着你。

column1: Fuuka turns and runs off down the hall.
column2: 风花转身沿走廊跑开了。

column1: Fuuka hurries off down the hall.
column2: 风花匆匆沿走廊走开了。

column1: The lounge of the dorm. You and Fuuka sit together, each reading a novel.
column2: 宿舍休息区。你和风花坐在一起，各自读着一本小说。

column1: The lounge of the dorm. You and Fuuka sit on benches facing each other across a low table, you reading the science fiction novel she has lent you while she reads her own.
column2: 宿舍休息区。你和风花隔着矮桌相对坐在长椅上，你读着她借给你的科幻小说，她读着自己的那本。

column1: The dorm lounge. You and Fuuka sit facing each other across a low table, each reading a volume of her science fiction series.
column2: 宿舍休息区。你和风花隔着矮桌相对而坐，各自读着她的科幻系列的一册。

column1: The lounge of the dorm. You and Fuuka sit reading together, both deep in the last volumes of the series.
column2: 宿舍休息区。你和风花坐在一起读书，两人都沉浸在这个系列的最后几册里。

column1: The dorm rooftop. You and Fuuka crouch side by side at the vegetable planters, working quietly.
column2: 宿舍天台。你和风花并肩蹲在蔬菜花盆旁，安静地干活。

column1: The dorm rooftop. You and Fuuka kneel side by side at the vegetable planters.
column2: 宿舍天台。你和风花并肩跪在蔬菜花盆旁。

column1: Later, you both stand by the planters, and Fuuka turns to you, her hands at her chest.
column2: 过了一会儿，你们都站在花盆旁，风花转向你，双手放在胸前。

column1: The dorm rooftop. You and Fuuka crouch side by side at the vegetable planters, working.
column2: 宿舍天台。你和风花并肩蹲在蔬菜花盆旁，干着活。

column1: Later, the work done, you and Fuuka stand facing each other by the planters.
column2: 过了一会儿，活干完了，你和风花面对面站在花盆旁。

column1: The dorm rooftop. You and Fuuka crouch side by side at the vegetable planters, looking over the plants, now growing well again.
column2: 宿舍天台。你和风花并肩蹲在蔬菜花盆旁，查看植物，它们现在又长得很好了。

column1: Camera footage plays: Fuuka alone in her room at the dorm, trying on a halter-top bikini and looking herself over.
column2: 监控画面播放着：风花独自在宿舍房间里，试穿一件挂脖式比基尼，打量着自己。

column1: Fuuka turns and walks over to her table, and comes back with a small pad.
column2: 风花转身走到桌旁，拿回来一个小垫子。

column1: Fuuka wraps the pad around her waist like a belt and switches it on. It starts to buzz, and she doubles over, clutching her middle and squirming.
column2: 风花把垫子像腰带一样围在腰上，打开开关。它开始嗡嗡作响，她弯下身子，抱着肚子扭动起来。

column1: Naganaki Shrine. You and Aigis walk up to the foot of the stone steps and stop side by side.
column2: 长鸣神社。你和埃癸斯走到石阶脚下，并肩停下。

column1: The school rooftop. Aigis walks over to the railing, and you join her there.
column2: 学校天台。埃癸斯走到栏杆旁，你也走到她身边。

column1: You and Aigis come down the steps outside Iwatodai Station when two dogs, one of them a black Shiba Inu, and a brown cat run up and plant themselves in your way.
column2: 你和埃癸斯走下严户台站外的台阶时，两只狗，其中一只是黑柴犬，和一只棕色的猫跑过来，挡在你们面前。

column1: Aigis steps toward the animals, and the black Shiba Inu lunges and bites her hand.
column2: 埃癸斯朝那些动物走去，黑柴犬扑上来咬了她的手。

column2: 两只狗和那只猫转身跑开了。

column1: Aigis turns and walks away, leaving you alone at the station.
column2: 埃癸斯转身走开，把你一个人留在车站。

column1: Paulownia Mall, Fountain Square. An elderly woman paces stooped by the fountain, looking around. You and Aigis walk across the plaza, and she comes up to you.
column2: 桐叶购物中心，喷泉广场。一位老太太弯着腰在喷泉旁踱步，四处张望。你和埃癸斯穿过广场，她走向你们。

column1: The old lady bows and shuffles off past you, and Aigis turns to you.
column2: 老太太鞠了一躬，拖着脚步从你身旁走过，埃癸斯转向你。

column1: Port Island Station. You and Aigis make your way across the plaza among the passers-by, looking around; you scratch the back of your head as Aigis moves on ahead, searching.
column2: 辰巳港湾人工岛站前。你和埃癸斯在行人中穿过广场，四处张望；埃癸斯向前搜寻时，你挠着后脑勺。

column1: Iwatodai Strip Mall, by the bicycles parked outside Wilduck Burger. You and Aigis look around.
column2: 严户台站前商店街，怀老鸭汉堡外停放的自行车旁。你和埃癸斯四处张望。

column1: Naganaki Shrine. You crouch near the steps, searching the ground, then stand and turn as Aigis walks back over to you from across the grounds.
column2: 长鸣神社。你蹲在台阶附近，搜寻地面，然后站起来转身，埃癸斯从境内另一头走回你身边。

column1: Port Island Station. You and Aigis walk across the plaza.
column2: 辰巳港湾人工岛站前。你和埃癸斯穿过广场。

column1: Aigis turns and runs toward the sound, and you follow. A cat sits on a bench, and Aigis crouches in front of it.
column2: 埃癸斯转身朝声音的方向跑去，你跟着。一只猫坐在长椅上，埃癸斯在它面前蹲下。

column1: Paulownia Mall, Fountain Square. An old lady sits on a bench by the fountain with her cat beside her on the bench. You and Aigis stand in front of her, having brought the cat back.
column2: 桐叶购物中心，喷泉广场。一位老太太坐在喷泉旁的长椅上，她的猫在长椅上陪着她。你和埃癸斯站在她面前，把猫送了回来。

column1: The old lady has gone home with her cat. You and Aigis stand alone in the square, Aigis holding her bag at her side.
column2: 老太太已经带着猫回家了。你和埃癸斯独自站在广场上，埃癸斯把包提在身侧。

column1: Iwatodai Strip Mall. You and Aigis come upon the old lady talking with a smirking student.
column2: 严户台站前商店街。你和埃癸斯撞见老太太正和一个咧嘴坏笑的学生说话。

column1: Kiyoshi walks off past you, and the old lady stays where she is, hands clasped. Aigis turns to look after Kiyoshi.
column2: 清从你身旁走过，老太太留在原地，双手交握。埃癸斯转头目送清离开。

column1: Aigis sets off after him, and you follow.
column2: 埃癸斯追着他走去，你跟在后面。

column1: Iwatodai Station. You and Aigis come up behind a boy walking through the crowd.
column2: 严户台站前。你和埃癸斯走到一个在人群中行走的男孩身后。

column1: Kiyoshi turns his back on Aigis and walks off up the station steps. Aigis watches him go, her face sad.
column2: 清转身背对埃癸斯，走上车站台阶。埃癸斯目送他离开，脸上带着悲伤。

column1: Fountain Square in Paulownia Mall. You are walking with Aigis when an old woman comes toward you.
column2: 桐叶购物中心的喷泉广场。你和埃癸斯正走着，一位老太太朝你们走来。

column1: The old woman bows to you both and turns to walk away.
column2: 老太太向你们两人鞠躬，然后转身走开。
